questions.question: Please introduce yourself.
answer: Hi, my name is Alex Sample. I'm a test engineer with three years of experience in consumer electronics.
In my current job, I troubleshoot faulty devices and write test procedures for the production line.
Now I'd like to bring my testing skills to {{Industry}}.

followUps.q: What kind of devices do you test?

questions.question: Why do you want to join {{Company}}?
questions.editNote: Sample of an edited template answer.
answer: I believe my detail-oriented approach to testing would help the team, especially in {{RoleFocus}}.

questions.question: What is your greatest strength?
answer: My greatest strength is staying calm when I troubleshoot.
When something fails, I first prioritize the most likely causes, then test them one by one.
This helps me find the problem faster and keep the team informed.
keyPoints: Prioritize likely causes → test one by one

stories.title: Production line fault
stories.situation: A production line stopped because a test station kept failing.
stories.action: Checked the wiring, then the test software, and found a wrong configuration value.
stories.result: The line restarted the same day.
